metadata.captureBoundary: Current working tree before durable net identity implementation; includes native pin-intent migration 0021_pin_electrical_intent.sql, not the older d5547f9 baseline
metadata.payloadHashEncoding: SHA-256 of UTF-8 JSON.stringify(payload); fixed key order, every table array sorted by id; raw JSON column strings unchanged
metadata.timestampsAndIds: Actual SDK-generated UUIDs and timestamps; capture output is an immutable observed snapshot, not byte-identical across reruns
metadata.privacy: Only design fixtures and source-file hashes captured; no environment values, credentials or provider data
deviations: Copper authoring uses legality: off to capture binding facts; fixture names do not claim manufacturing or circuit qualification
Each passive two-pad capacitor fixture supplies one isolated two-pin net by wiring its two symbol pins together; this tests identity and persistence, not a functional circuit

SDK creates trace geometry and history; narrow imported-style adapter adds netName to exactly four raw trace payloads because native trace commands expose no netName. Adapter does not rewrite existing history or command rows.
